sample_mapping_evidence: Explicit GEO contributor/Vireo crosswalk:four Lyme donors T1/T4 plus eight baseline controls. L203264_T1 appears in two technical captures and is one biological specimen; combine cells while rejecting exact barcode/count duplication across libraries. Vireo model confidence>=0.90, doublet probability<=0.10, informative variants>0, exclude doublet/unassigned.

source_metadata.access: Public original RNA H5 and genetic donor-assignment tables; raw sequence not required
source_metadata.demographics: Adult cohort; ages/sex absent from individual GEO records, no imputation
source_processing: Illumina base-call files were converted to demultiplexed FASTQ files with Cell Ranger mkfastq v6.0.1. The libraries were sequenced across four lanes of flow cell HY2YGDSX3.
FASTQ reads were aligned, cells identified and genes counted with Cell Ranger count v3.0.2 using the human GRCh38-3.0.0 reference and an expected cell number of 8,000 per library.

Cells in each library were assigned to Vireo donor clusters, doublet, or unassigned categories with Vireo v0.5.8. Donor labels were mapped to coded specimens using sex-linked expression and cohort records or genotype concordance across paired libraries, as applicable. Sample descriptions give the mappings.
Low-quality cells were removed with scuttle quickPerCellQC v1.14.0 based on library size and detected features; cells with a high proportion of mitochondrial transcripts were also removed.

Gene-by-cell matrices were log-normalized with Seurat NormalizeData and integrated by canonical correlation analysis in Seurat v5.3.0. Cells with fewer than 500 unique features were removed after integration. PCA, UMAP, and shared-nearest-neighbor clustering used the first 30 principal components; cell types were annotated with SingleR v2.6.0 using the Monaco reference.
Supplementary files format and content: Per-library 10x Genomics Cell Ranger filtered feature-barcode matrix in HDF5 format (.h5): genes by filtered cell barcodes, with UMI count values.

Supplementary files format and content: Each library has a tab-delimited Vireo donor-assignment file (.tsv) with columns cell, donor_id, prob_max, prob_doublet, n_vars, best_singlet, and best_doublet. Values of donor_id are donor0, donor1, donor2 where applicable, doublet, or unassigned. Sample descriptions map donor labels to coded patient specimens.

title: PBMC pooled library L204127_T1
characteristics_ch1: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cells
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood was collected in K2EDTA tubes and processed within two hours while maintained on ice. PBMCs were isolated by Ficoll density-gradient centrifugation (2,000 rpm for 20 min at room temperature, no brake), washed in RPMI (1,500 rpm for 7 min at room temperature), counted and assessed for viability. PBMCs were cryopreserved in 10% DMSO in FBS and stored in liquid nitrogen until use.

Eight 10x Genomics Chromium bead libraries were prepared from pooled PBMC specimens. The planned two-specimen pools used equal cell concentrations, targeting 4,000 cells per specimen.
